title: The Silent Cron
story: The cleanup job should run every night, yet logs keep piling up. Cron has been quiet.
goal: Find the problem in the crontab file and fix the schedule so it runs at 02:30 every day.

files./var/spool/cron/crontabs/oncall:
# m h dom mon dow command
30 2 31 2 * /opt/cleanup.sh

hints: Read the five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. Is 31 February a real date?
Replace '31 2' with '* *' using sed -i on the crontab file.
socratic: Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
